mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate below 4.8% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market interprets the labor market strengthening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 4.8% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above historical averages signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and HOUST does not result in statistically significant positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.35% signals policy accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS does not decline below 0.35% or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index points signals supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently above 100 index points or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in job creation (PAYEMS) exceeding 143,210 indicates a robust labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 143,210 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A confluence of rising GDP (GDPC1) and manufacturing activity (RSAFS) above key thresholds signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS does not produce statistically significant positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 99 index points signals supply-side momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a late-cycle expansion, INDPRO does not rise above 99 index points or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
